name: aba
title: The ABA problem
summary: Every worker pops a node from a stack of three and pushes it back, round after round, so nodes leave and return while another worker is between its read of the head and its compare-and-swap. The page counts the pops that returned a node nobody had pushed.

controls.name: head
controls.label: The head
controls.hint: plain: an index, compared and swapped alone. tagged: an index and a version counter, compared and swapped together as one 64-bit word.

results.name: pops
results.label: Pops
results.what: pops that returned a node, all workers

results.name: corrupt
results.label: Not in the stack
results.what: pops that returned a node no push had put there: the head was swung to a node another worker held

results.name: in_stack
results.label: In the stack at the end
results.what: nodes reachable from the head; three to start, and more than the pool has means the stack loops

results.name: elapsed
results.label: Elapsed
results.what: from the start barrier opening to the last worker finishing

trace.what: the classic interleaving: a thread reads the head and the node below, the world changes and changes back, and its compare-and-swap succeeds
